Class SimulationMetricsAggregator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.SimulationMetricsAggregator
public final class SimulationMetricsAggregator extends Object

SimulationMetricsAggregator

Aggregates and coordinates macroscopic, cliodynamic, thermodynamic, ecological, and demographic metrics for the planetary simulation engine.
Delegates domain-specific closed-form equations to ThermodynamicMetricsHelper, DemographicMetricsHelper, EnvironmentalMetricsHelper, CliodynamicMetricsHelper, MacroeconomicMetricsHelper, and CulturalKnowledgeMetricsHelper.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
